headline: The reading I was missing at 08:00 has landed - HRV 64, above baseline, and the gate is open for the full 85 km.
body:
Yesterday's rest day did exactly what it was there for. Last night's HRV came in at **64 against a 14-day mean of 61** - your first above-baseline morning since 31 August, after four straight below it, Wednesday bottoming at **48**. Resting HR **46**, one beat off your 14-day best, body battery never fell under **46** overnight, **8.4 h sleep with 85 min deep**.

So it is the full session, not the 65 km fallback. **85 km at 140-150 bpm**, 28-31 km/h where it is flat, **cap 155 on the climbs** and ignore the speed, keep pedalling over the top. Then straight off the bike, no sitting down: **35 min at 6:45-7:00/km, 145-155 bpm**. Fuel **80-90 g/hr** from the first hour, not the third.

Garmin still prints your HRV status as Low - that is its seven-day lag, not this morning. If anything has to go out there, cut bike kilometres. The run is the point.

Ankle before you roll out?
